title: Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse Disclosed Sales of JPMorgan, Visa and Analog Devices (Oct 1)
content:
Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse (RI) disclosed three stock sales on October 1, 2026, all dated September 4: JPMorgan Chase (JPM), Visa (V) and Analog Devices (ADI).

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

TickerCompanyType / sizePrice at sale vs. Oct 2 (Bargo est.)
JPMJPMorgan Chase & Co.Sale, $15,001–$50,000$358.64 vs. $332.38 (−7.32%)
VVisa Inc.Sale, $1,001–$15,000$375.07 vs. $360.66 (−3.84%)
ADIAnalog Devices, Inc.Sale, $1,001–$15,000$362.25 vs. $417.15 (+15.16%)

Transaction date for all three: Sep 4, 2026. Disclosure date: Oct 1, 2026 (27 days later). Member: Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse, RI (Senate).

What's been disclosed

  • Three sales: JPMorgan Chase ($15,001–$50,000), Visa ($1,001–$15,000) and Analog Devices ($1,001–$15,000), all on September 4.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts JPMorgan about 7.3% and Visa about 3.8% lower on October 2 than on the sale date, and Analog Devices about 15.2% higher.
  • Row count: Bargo's data lists 5 rows for this filing. Two pairs of rows (JPMorgan and Visa) are exact repeats, which leaves the 3 distinct trades shown above.

Quick FAQ

Why does the post say 3 trades when the data has 5 rows?
Two rows are exact copies of another row. The data does not show whether they are duplicate entries or separate transactions with identical details, so we count the 3 distinct trades.

How long after the sales were they disclosed?
27 days. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the October 2 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.

Trade data from Bargo (STOCK Act filings). This post is our own summary of public filings and is not investment advice. See our Disclaimer and evidence labels.
